Introduction to C# Programming

The module develops the fundamental programming knowledge and problem-solving skills required to create structured C# programs and small interactive game systems.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Demonstrate understanding of fundamental C# programming concepts and explainhow data, statements, expressions and control structures determine programme behaviour.

+  Develop, test and debug procedural C# solutions using appropriate variables, operators, conditions, loops, methods, strings, collections and introductory algorithms.

+  Design and implement object-oriented C# programs using classes, objects, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism and abstraction to organise related data and behaviour.

+  Apply programming problem-solving, testing and reflective development practices to create, explain and evaluate a complete interactive C# programme.
